title: TeamAndOrgViewSetMixin: scoping and permission enforcement
answers: How is team/org scoping enforced in viewsets?
Which methods can't I override in a viewset?
What permission classes are applied by default?
body:
`posthog/api/routing.py:TeamAndOrgViewSetMixin` must be the FIRST base class of viewsets.
- `__init_subclass__` raises if subclass overrides get_queryset/get_object/get_permissions/get_authenticators. Use `safely_get_queryset`, `safely_get_object`, or the `permission_classes` attr; `dangerously_*` variants are escape hatches.
- get_queryset applies `_filter_queryset_by_parents_lookups` (team_id, or `team__project_id` for project_id; `filter_rewrite_rules` remaps), and `_filter_queryset_by_access_level` on list only.
- get_permissions chain: IsAuthenticated, APIScopePermission, AccessControlPermission, TeamMemberAccessPermission (or OrganizationMemberPermissions for org views), VerifiedDomainEnforcementPermission, MCPAccessPermission, ActiveOrganizationPermission, then class permission_classes (all in posthog/permissions.py).
- Set `scope_object` (APIScopeObject in posthog/scopes.py) and optionally `required_scopes`.
- `initial` sets ContextVar canonical team id for ORM fail-closed scoping (posthog/models/scoping/README.md, TeamScopeError); outside DRF use for_team()/team_scope()/@with_team_scope().
- Serializers read team via `self.context["get_team"]()`.
applies: Viewsets under posthog/api and products using the mixin; permission list partly from a truncated read.

Requires scope_object (APIScopeObject from posthog/scopes.py) and optional required_scopes; sets ContextVar canonical team id via initial() for ORM fail-closed scoping (TeamScopeError, for_team(), team_scope(), @with_team_scope()). Serializers read team via self.context["get_team"](). Applies to viewsets under posthog/api and products using the mixin.
